residual.detail: Ledger.remove(sku, qty) in audit-target/inventory/stock.py never raises ValueError when qty exceeds current stock; item.qty -= qty is unconditional. Violates SPEC.md: 'Ledger.remove(sku, qty): raise ValueError if qty exceeds current stock.'
Ledger.low_stock(threshold) in audit-target/inventory/stock.py uses `qty < threshold` instead of SPEC.md's `qty <= threshold`, so items exactly at the threshold are omitted.

parse_csv_line in audit-target/inventory/report.py casts the CSV price field with bare int(price) and never converts price_dollars to price_cents (no *100), contradicting SPEC.md: 'CSV rows are sku,qty,price_dollars; the ledger stores cents.'
No test in audit-target/test_stock.py exercises Ledger.remove() at all, so neither the decrement path nor the required ValueError-on-overdraw path is covered.
No test in audit-target/test_stock.py exercises Ledger.low_stock() at all.
No test in audit-target/test_stock.py exercises parse_csv_line at all.
Ledger.add() on an existing sku discards the new price_cents argument and keeps the original stale price; SPEC.md is silent on the intended repeat-add price policy.
Ledger.remove() raises KeyError (not ValueError) for an unknown sku; SPEC.md does not specify unknown-sku behavior.
test_add_and_total only exercises one sku with an identical repeated price; it never covers multi-sku summation in total_value_cents() or a repeat add() with a differing price.
